title: refactor(unified-rollouts): simplify canary/AB/shadow autorollback workflow
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: Our existing autorollback behavior for canary, A/B and shadow rollouts has accrued duplication and subtle divergence across three separate code paths (canary engine, shadow probe, AB balancer). This PR centralizes the autorollback decision engine, unifies policy evaluation across rollout modes, and adds clearer observability and safety guards. Changes include a compact state machine for rollout stages, pluggable metric adapters for quorum/composite metrics, a common preflight/probing step, and stability guards to avoid oscillation between rollback and restore. The description below summarizes intent, risk, testing, and rollout plan. Intent: 1) Replace three conditional implementations with a single autorollback engine that evaluates composite metrics with configurable quorums and hysteresis. 2) Ensure canary, A/B and shadow flows use the same metric thresholds and observability hooks so SREs and product engineers see a consistent view. 3) Reduce flakiness in e2e tests by adding explicit stability windows and by defaulting to conservative timeouts. Risk and mitigations: refactor-only (no behavioral policy change by default). Feature gated behind rollout.v2.enabled flag; safe default config keeps previous behavior. E2E tests and staging evaluation executed before merge. Checklist: - [x] Design doc (Linear ENG-3421) reviewed - [x] Unit + integration tests added - [x] E2E canary/AB/shadow scenarios validated in staging - [x] Observability dashboards updated - [x] Feature gated and rollout plan documented What changed (summary): - New central autorollback engine (rollouts/autorollback/engine.go) with a small state machine and plugin hooks for metric adapters. - Metric adapters for latency/error-rate/composite-quorum added. - Stability guard layer implements hysteresis and quarantine windows. - Observability: per-rollout metric streams, tracing spans, and reason codes for rollback events. - API and Console: rollout config schema extended with compatibility fallback; Console shows rollback reason and timeline. Testing: added unit tests for engine logic, integration tests for metric adapters, and e2e scenarios that exercise canary, A/B and shadow paths. Staging runs showed identical rollback decisions compared to baseline when feature gate off, and deterministic improved stability when gate on with conservative defaults. Rollout plan: behind rollout.v2.enabled feature flag. Gradual rollout to 10% of production accounts for 48h, monitor canary SLOs and rollback reasons, then 100% if stable. Follow-up: expose autorollback timeline in Console and add additional metric adapters for safety-critical customers.

review_comments: Marco Liu (reviewer): Can you clarify how the composite quorum handles missing signals from legacy metric exporters?
Priya Nair (author): The metric adapters include a 'grace' window; if a signal is missing we fall back to replica-aware defaults and emit a rollup_missing_signal metric for alerting.
Aisha Patel (reviewer): I saw a flake in the e2e where the quarantine window didn't engage on the first rollback. Can you add an assertion?
Priya Nair (author): Added a test that simulates transient spikes and asserts quarantine state entry; also tightened the timeouts in the e2e harness.
Diego Ramos (reviewer): Observability look good but please ensure the rollback reason codes are stable (no churn across minor versions).
Priya Nair (author): Rollback reason codes are now defined in rollouts/api/v1/reason_codes.proto and included in the changelog; they are intentionally additive only.
Aisha Patel (approver): Approving after staging validation and CI green. Left a small nit on comments formatting.

notes: Post-merge: schedule a canary rollout for 10% of accounts for 48h, monitor rollout/rollback_reason metrics and rollout.v2.feature_toggle. Follow-up PR planned to add additional metric adapters for request-level latency histograms.
release_notes: Refactor: unified autorollback engine for canary/A-B/shadow rollouts; added stability guards and composite metric quorum adapters. Feature gated; no default behavior change. Improves consistency of rollback decisions and observability.
